techStack: - Built with Next.js 16, React 19, and Tailwind v4. Shadcn for some components.
- Framer Motion for animations; react-rnd for draggable windows in the computer view. Custom pieces: desk hitbox, DesktopIcon, FolderWindow, menu bar.
- Typography: Newsreader for headings and Inter for body, via next/font with subsetting.

timeline.title: Now
timeline.description: This iteration is heavily inspired by Paul, Chester, and Gregory — credit to this site for helping me find them. I wanted my website to feel like a desk with all of my favorite things on it. Weirdly enough, my desk is incredibly messy and I hate doing work on it. I also realized there's just way too much going on in my website, but this is my website and I have way too many fun ideas I want to add. (More updates coming soon!)

content.summary: Here are the fully finished projects that I've worked on and that I am proud of. Not much to see right now, but hopefully will have a lot in the future.

hobbies.description: I love doing things! This page is dedicated to exactly those things. Chances are I love talking about these things as well, so feel free to reach out. Things, things, things...

workbench.description: This page is for what I am currently working on and a bunch of random projects or ideas in the back of my mind. I have a lot of brilliantly dumb ideas that you are free to explore.
